notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.notes:
[p][b]Bartender & Soul Coins:[/b] 
Soul coins can be found from defeating bosses and opening chests, talk to the bartender to spend them between runs! You spend them on unlocking potion drops (Speed, Attack, and Chaos potions), or on item buffs (increased rarity, increased enemy drops, and Loki's Loot discount). 

[b]Status UI:[/b]
Now shows when you have buffs and debuffs: speed up/down, hit vulnerability/invulnerability, and damage increase/decrease. 

[b]Overgrowth Biome:[/b] 
Take place in circle 3, is our new time trial circle!

[b]Corrupted Fire Hydrant enemy:
[/b]Can be found in the Overgrowth biome. Don't let him steal your water!
[/p][p][b]Loki's Loot shop improvements:[/b]
Random Loki's Loot employees will now spawn in the in the shops. They'll sometimes offer you a discount on an item if you purchased the Loki's Loot discount from the purgatory bartender! [/p]

notes.title: 0.6.1 Cat Update
notes.notes:
As we work towards our 0.7 update we have a regular update for you!

New fire cat can be found in the hub! If he's in the mood you can pet him, otherwise watch out for his bite!

A number of players have provided fair criticism about the not water in the Cove circle. Falling into this no longer inflicts damage on the player, and has more appropriate animation & VFX. We also made special behaviors for the Lava and Obsidian circle(the latter may lead to a secret).

The Wizard takes on new arcane powers in the Ice and Obsidian circles! Be careful as the Arcane Wizard has a much larger arsenal of spells to make these late game circles more challenging!

notes.title: 0.6 Golden Palace Time Trial Update
notes.notes:
We added a new time trial circle between the Desert and Ice circles. This circle has some amazing loot and lots of chests to help you defeat the last bosses, but don't get greedy looting for to long, or you might not make it out alive!
[list]
[*]Gold Biome time trial circle.
[*]Hub content, enemy stats and new characters, other improvements.
[*]Achievements! Complete achievements for defeating bosses and enemies.
[*]Toad Man enemy can be found in the cove biome, stay away from his spit!
[*]Goblin enemy can now be encountered in the Gold biome, don't let him steal your coins!
[*]Disciple and God item sets added to the game.
[*]Improvements to the map.
[*]New game audio. We got bloops, blops, and even bops!
[*]Lots of bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.5.2 Accessibility Update
notes.notes:
Some features where added to help with accessibility such as to address colour blindness issues and making more progress on controller support for those who need one. And other accessibility adjacent / game design features where added.
[list]
[*] Shadow effect when player is jumping
[*] Added mini map (Open by pressing M on the keyboard or press right stick button on controller)
[*] Controller support in menus (controller support is still experimental / work in progress)
[*] Increased size of cursor
[*] Changed colour / art and added colour variants of enemies to help with visibility
[/list]
Other changes include:
[list]
[*] Potential fix for bug where items would drop from enemies much more frequently than intended on some users hardware
[*] Added VFX for Leviathan ground slam attack
[*] Misc. fixes
[/list]
We will continue to improve the game with accessibility in mind, but if there are issues you've found while playing please let us know in our Discord, Community Hub, or Reviews!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas, all! We have new features for 0.5.1!
Electric Ghost: Be careful not to spray water on electricity!
New Whirlwind item set.
Santa Hat which can only be found for a short time!
Several new rooms and room balancing.
Lighting improvements.
Misc. changes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 0.5 Steam Release
notes.notes:
[h2]New Biome:[b]The Underworld Desert[/b][/h2] Completed with sandstorms and a day and night cycle, this biome brings some variety to the rocky locales of No Water in Hell.

[h2]New Boss: [b]Anubis[/b][/h2] Found in the underworld desert, Anubis brings minions, lasers, sandstorms and other wild attacks to challenge players with. We hope you enjoy the new challenge!

[h2]Our [b]soundtrack[/b] is expanded[/h2] And now is on YouTube in full force. Enjoy all 17 Tracks of No Water in Hell's Soundtrack.

[h2]New [b]Enemies[/b][/h2] Hell's legions grow more diverse with the addition of the Goblin, Baykok, the fire bat, Prisoners of Sand, and more.  They can be found in both old and new areas and should add some interesting challenge to all of your runs through the Underworld going forward!

[h2]New [b]Sound Effects[/b][/h2] Have you ever a spot in NWIH that could have used a bit of audio love? We've taken some time to do just that and added new sounds throughout the game, all thanks to Alexmd9 . They make NWIH sound and feel more alive and we hope you'll grow to love them the same way we have!

[h2]New [b]Physics[/b][/h2] Our physics are now better as they bring better physics than our physics previously brought physics to our physics-based game.

[b][h2]ITEMS ITEMS ITEMS![/h2][/b] We have new items, and they're bigger, badder, and better than ever. There's more of them with new and impressive effects to make every playthrough just a little bit different. Check it out!

[h2]Big News! We're on [b]Steam[/b] NOW![/h2] We're overjoyed to be able to finally share that our game has come to Steam officially in Early Access, and we plan to provide regular large content updates as we work towards 1.0 in 2024. This has been a long time coming for our team, and we've finally made it to Steam after 4 years of development.

0.5.0.14 was released as a hotfix for a curser bug and minor buffs to late game enemies.
